findings.description: V32 current sit/crouch images and sit thigh transects reject anterior coverage. At 52% along each evaluated UpperLeg bone, the current lap panels are posterior to the shorts (Blender anterior is negative Y): left lap median Y -0.0972 m vs left shorts -0.1606 m (63 mm posterior); right lap -0.1219 m vs right shorts -0.1616 m (40 mm posterior). Current measured coverage remains sit 0.2316/0.2237 and crouch 0.3514/0.3695 for the overskirt, versus 0.9548/0.9548 and 0.9537/0.9537 for shorts. The source-bound transect identifies the panel trajectory and nearest projections to the declared UpperLeg-weighted body triangle set; it does not establish fit acceptance.

Direct V32 front, sit, crouch and side renders show coarse triangular faceting, uneven split front edges, abrupt hem transitions, and narrow pointed tips. The attachment change moves front edges slightly without resolving visual continuity.
Direct inspection of current V32 rear render finds no clearly readable adjustment-tab or buckle silhouette; it remains visually merged with the garment and has no dedicated rear close-up.
Current V32 weighted prototype still has no authored UV map. UV remains MISSING; no substitute UV has been generated.
